name: Greg Goldberg

about: Greg Goldberg is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2009 - 2027. He works at Holland & Hart LLP, located in Denver, Colorado, and provides legal services for issues involving Criminal Defense: White Collar, Business Litigation, Appellate and Environmental to the surrounding community.
Greg Goldberg completed legal studies at Columbia Law School and graduated with the class of 1995. Greg Goldberg passed the bar in 1995.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
